query.name: com.lapromisefund.wildcathub.roster
query.description: Active student enrollments joined to section, course and teacher for one school and one term. Standard class fields only. No restricted fields.

arg.name: schoolid
arg.description: Schools.School_Number for the school being read

arg.name: termid
arg.description: Terms.ID for the term being read

query.sql: SELECT S.ID AS student_id, S.DCID AS student_dcid, S.STUDENT_NUMBER AS student_number, S.STATE_STUDENTNUMBER AS state_student_number, S.FIRST_NAME AS first_name, S.LAST_NAME AS last_name, S.GRADE_LEVEL AS grade_level, S.GENDER AS gender, S.ENROLL_STATUS AS enroll_status, -- Manifest field 19. Key linking a Google Workspace account on -- westbrookacademy.org to this record. STUDENT_EMAIL is the common -- spelling; if this install uses S.EMAIL or a u_ extension table -- instead, `npm run probe` reports it and this line changes. S.STUDENT_EMAIL AS student_email, SEC.ID AS section_id, SEC.DCID AS section_dcid, SEC.SECTION_NUMBER AS section_number, SEC.EXPRESSION AS section_expression, CC.EXPRESSION AS cc_expression, C.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number, C.COURSE_NAME AS course_name, TCH.ID AS teacher_id, TCH.TEACHERNUMBER AS teacher_number, TCH.FIRST_NAME AS teacher_first_name, TCH.LAST_NAME AS teacher_last_name, USR.EMAIL_ADDR AS teacher_email, T.ID AS term_id, T.ABBREVIATION AS term_abbreviation, S.SCHOOLID AS school_id FROM STUDENTS S JOIN CC ON CC.STUDENTID = S.ID JOIN SECTIONS SEC ON SEC.ID = CC.SECTIONID JOIN COURSES C ON C.COURSE_NUMBER = SEC.COURSE_NUMBER AND C.SCHOOLID = SEC.SCHOOLID JOIN TERMS T ON T.ID = CC.TERMID AND T.SCHOOLID = CC.SCHOOLID LEFT JOIN TEACHERS TCH ON TCH.ID = SEC.TEACHER LEFT JOIN USERS USR ON USR.DCID = TCH.USERS_DCID WHERE S.SCHOOLID = :schoolid AND CC.TERMID = :termid AND S.ENROLL_STATUS = 0 AND (CC.DATELEFT IS NULL OR CC.DATELEFT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE))

query.name: com.lapromisefund.wildcathub.attendance_summary
query.description: Days absent for one term and days absent year to date, counted as distinct calendar dates so period level (meeting mode) attendance is not multiplied by the number of periods. Bounded by the term record dates so no term id is hardcoded.

arg.name: schoolid
arg.description: Schools.School_Number for the school being read

arg.name: termid
arg.description: Terms.ID for the term being read

arg.name: yeartermid
arg.description: Terms.ID of the full year record (IsYearRec = 1)

query.sql: SELECT S.ID AS student_id, S.STUDENT_NUMBER AS student_number, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.ATT_DATE BETWEEN TM.FIRSTDAY AND TM.LASTDAY AND AC.PRESENCE_STATUS_CD = 'Absent' THEN A.ATT_DATE END ) AS days_absent_term, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN AC.PRESENCE_STATUS_CD = 'Absent' THEN A.ATT_DATE END ) AS days_absent_ytd, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN A.ATT_DATE BETWEEN TM.FIRSTDAY AND TM.LASTDAY AND AC.ATT_CODE = 'T' THEN A.ATT_DATE END ) AS days_tardy_term, COUNT(A.ID) AS attendance_rows_ytd, TM.FIRSTDAY AS term_first_day, TM.LASTDAY AS term_last_day FROM STUDENTS S JOIN TERMS TM ON TM.ID = :termid AND TM.SCHOOLID = :schoolid JOIN TERMS YR ON YR.ID = :yeartermid AND YR.SCHOOLID = :schoolid LEFT JOIN ATTENDANCE A ON A.STUDENTID = S.ID AND A.ATT_DATE BETWEEN YR.FIRSTDAY AND YR.LASTDAY AND A.ATT_MODE_CODE IN ('ATT_ModeDaily', 'ATT_ModeMeeting') LEFT JOIN ATTENDANCE_CODE AC ON AC.ID = A.ATTENDANCE_CODEID WHERE S.SCHOOLID = :schoolid AND S.ENROLL_STATUS = 0 GROUP BY S.ID, S.STUDENT_NUMBER, TM.FIRSTDAY, TM.LASTDAY

query.name: com.lapromisefund.wildcathub.grades
query.description: Current grade and percent per student per section. Live gradebook value when present, otherwise the stored grade for the same reporting term. Null percent is preserved as null.

arg.name: schoolid
arg.description: Schools.School_Number for the school being read

arg.name: termid
arg.description: Terms.ID for the term being read

arg.name: storecode
arg.description: StoredGrades.StoreCode fallback for the same reporting term

query.sql: SELECT S.ID AS student_id, S.STUDENT_NUMBER AS student_number, SEC.ID AS section_id, C.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_number, C.COURSE_NAME AS course_name, COALESCE(PGF.GRADE, SG.GRADE) AS current_grade, COALESCE(PGF.PERCENT, SG.PERCENT) AS current_percent, CASE WHEN PGF.GRADE IS NOT NULL OR PGF.PERCENT IS NOT NULL THEN 'PGFinalGrades' WHEN SG.GRADE IS NOT NULL OR SG.PERCENT IS NOT NULL THEN 'StoredGrades' ELSE 'NONE' END AS grade_source, PGF.LASTGRADEUPDATE AS last_grade_update FROM STUDENTS S JOIN CC ON CC.STUDENTID = S.ID JOIN SECTIONS SEC ON SEC.ID = CC.SECTIONID JOIN COURSES C ON C.COURSE_NUMBER = SEC.COURSE_NUMBER AND C.SCHOOLID = SEC.SCHOOLID LEFT JOIN PGFINALGRADES PGF ON PGF.STUDENTID = S.ID AND PGF.SECTIONID = SEC.ID AND PGF.FINALGRADENAME = :finalgradename LEFT JOIN STOREDGRADES SG ON SG.STUDENTID = S.ID AND SG.SECTIONID = SEC.ID AND SG.STORECODE = :storecode WHERE S.SCHOOLID = :schoolid AND CC.TERMID = :termid AND S.ENROLL_STATUS = 0

query.name: com.lapromisefund.wildcathub.staff
query.description: Active staff for one school with the identifiers the Hub needs to key a signed in Google account to a PowerSchool teacher record.

arg.name: schoolid
arg.description: Schools.School_Number for the school being read

query.sql: SELECT USR.DCID AS user_dcid, TCH.ID AS teacher_id, USR.TEACHERNUMBER AS teacher_number, USR.FIRST_NAME AS first_name, USR.LAST_NAME AS last_name, USR.EMAIL_ADDR AS email_addr, SS.SCHOOLID AS school_id, SS.STAFFSTATUS AS staff_status, SS.STATUS AS status, CASE WHEN NVL(SECS.SECTION_COUNT, 0) > 0 THEN 'HAS_SECTIONS' ELSE 'NO_SECTIONS' END AS role_hint, NVL(SECS.SECTION_COUNT, 0) AS section_count FROM USERS USR JOIN SCHOOLSTAFF SS ON SS.USERS_DCID = USR.DCID LEFT JOIN TEACHERS TCH ON TCH.USERS_DCID = USR.DCID AND TCH.SCHOOLID = SS.SCHOOLID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SEC.TEACHER AS TEACHER_ID, COUNT(SEC.ID) AS SECTION_COUNT FROM SECTIONS SEC GROUP BY SEC.TEACHER ) SECS ON SECS.TEACHER_ID = TCH.ID WHERE SS.SCHOOLID = :schoolid AND SS.STATUS = 1

query.name: com.lapromisefund.wildcathub.student_race_restricted
query.description: RESTRICTED. One to many. Multi race students return one row per code. Callers must not collapse this to a single value.

arg.name: schoolid
arg.description: Schools.School_Number for the school being read

query.sql: SELECT S.ID AS student_id, S.STUDENT_NUMBER AS student_number, SR.RACECD AS race_code FROM STUDENTS S JOIN STUDENTRACE SR ON SR.STUDENTID = S.ID WHERE S.SCHOOLID = :schoolid AND S.ENROLL_STATUS = 0

query.name: com.lapromisefund.wildcathub.student_restricted
query.description: RESTRICTED. Federal ethnicity flag and current English Learner status from the California state extension. Loads into its own staging table.

arg.name: schoolid
arg.description: Schools.School_Number for the school being read

query.sql: SELECT S.ID AS student_id, S.STUDENT_NUMBER AS student_number, S.FEDETHNICITY AS fed_ethnicity, X.ELASTATUS AS ela_status FROM STUDENTS S LEFT JOIN S_CA_STU_X X ON X.STUDENTSDCID = S.DCID WHERE S.SCHOOLID = :schoolid AND S.ENROLL_STATUS = 0

query.name: com.lapromisefund.wildcathub.terms
query.description: Every term for one school and one school year, including the full year record. Used to resolve :termid and :yeartermid at run time so nothing hardcodes a term.

arg.name: schoolid
arg.description: Schools.School_Number for the school being read

arg.name: yearid
arg.description: Terms.YearID for the school year being read

query.sql: SELECT T.ID AS term_id, T.ABBREVIATION AS abbreviation, T.NAME AS name, T.FIRSTDAY AS first_day, T.LASTDAY AS last_day, T.ISYEARREC AS is_year_rec, T.PORTION AS portion, T.SCHOOLID AS school_id, T.YEARID AS year_id FROM TERMS T WHERE T.SCHOOLID = :schoolid AND T.YEARID = :yearid ORDER BY T.ISYEARREC DESC, T.FIRSTDAY
